settings.motion_prompt: 4-second one-shot seated slow-building anger reaction. Start in the supplied SCREEN-LEFT-facing pose, mouth closed. During the first 2 seconds, gradually narrow the eyes, tighten the jaw and build restrained tension in the shoulders; never snap or jerk. Hold the contained anger clearly for about 1 second, then slowly release the tension over the final second and return to the exact approved starting pose. Keep looking toward the off-screen listener on SCREEN-LEFT. Preserve face, moustache, large body mass, clothing, painted style, seated proportions, canvas and scale. Hands, hips, legs and feet stay anchored. Fixed camera; transparent background. No speaking, laughter, viewer-facing turn, mirroring, standing, large arm gesture, drift, new props, chair, table, background or shadow. One reaction only, not a looping angry idle.
